snippet.title: Riptide Sea Shanty (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
A sea shanty sung by The Riptide Pirates!

♫ "shanty schmove." created by Shady Cicada: https://twitter.com/ShadyCicada ♫ 
written and preformed by the JRWI CAST

art by Lanla: https://twitter.com/WeeeLanladesu
animated by Grassfur: https://twitter.com/Grassfur
animation assist by Shan: https://twitter.com/shanuraru
subtitles by Ikarus: https://twitter.com/KenIkarusTweet
thank you for joining us as Ichabod Jonah!: https://twitter.com/ImMrTransistor
https://twitter.com/AlphaAniki

This shanty was created as a reward for our patrons and us hitting a goal! The patrons got early access to this shanty a WHILE ago, so come support and get access to much more content! like...
OUR EXCLUSIVE VAMPIRE CAMPAIGN!: 
https://www.patreon.com/JustRollWithIt

Lyrics: 
(chip)
ill tell you a tale
let the bastard regale
of how pirates like us came to be
sit down, take a seat
theres a whole crew to meet
and the best captains ever at sea

(jay)
a ferin by name
with incredible aim
this girl is a soldier no more
the sea at her feet
with compass and sheet
she'll guide us our way through the storm

(gillion)
GILLION!
yes, i'm the one
monsoon and moon son
moisture master and paramount champion
i smite evil with glee
things are often my B
but as it was foretold
this is my Destiny!!

(all)
YO HO HOME ON THE SEA
TAKE MY HAND AND YOULL BE FREE
SET... SAIL.. TO FIND OUR DESTINY
YO HO WE SAIL ACROSS
THE SEAS UPON THE ALBATROSS
UNDER THE MOON
AND UNDER THE SUN
A PIRATES LIFE UNTIL WE'RE DONE!

(chip)
lost and alone
no where to call my home
til a whole bunch of pirates
took me on their boat
and then
they all died
in a horrible, tragic, way
and now i walk around and just pretend its all okay

(jay)
but then you came to sea
and found my mom and me
and took gil by the hand 
and now we are a family
though at first it was a lie
i had almost said goodbye
but without me here, i really fear
that none of you would survive

(gillion)
yes its a hard life
and chip has a wife
its so painful to see her go through all this strife
and jays dad isnt the best
he keeps a sword close to his chest
and together we fly our flag
and upon it...
thats breasts.

(all)
YO HO HOME ON THE SEA
TAKE MY HAND AND YOULL BE FREE
SET... SAIL.. TO FIND OUR DESTINY
YO HO WE SAIL ACROSS
THE SEAS UPON THE ALBATROSS
UNDER THE MOON
AND UNDER THE SUN
A PIRATES LIFE UNTIL WE'RE DONE!

(earl) 
when my wife had died
i started a new life 
its full of juice and full of--

(drey)
aint no body wanna hear you sing

(earl)
what the-
you want a piece of me huh?

(gryffon)
knock it off old man

(earl)
ill knock it off when he fuckin knocks it off-

(drey)
you sound like a dying goat

(gryffon)
ah shit

(earl)
BAH thats it im gonna break my foot off up in your-

(queen sings gently in the background)

(ollie & felipe)
Sailing through the seas and the wind will guide us
i want to be a pirate for the rest of my life!
no need to look for treasure, as ive already found it
this adventure with my crew... is a dream come true!!

(ichabod)
now everyone, repeat after me
this oath right here will be your creed
i swear to fuck shit up and always help the ones i need...
no matter what, we'll roll with it
and lastly we swear to be
the best god damn pirates
this world has ever seen

(all)
YO HO HOME ON THE SEA
TAKE MY HAND AND YOULL BE FREE
SET... SAIL.. TO FIND OUR DESTINY
YO HO WE SAIL ACROSS
THE SEAS UPON THE ALBATROSS
UNDER THE MOON
AND UNDER THE SUN
A PIRATES LIFE UNTIL WE'RE DONE!

YO HO HOLE IN THE SEA
IF I FELL WOULD YOU COME FOR ME
TAKE MY HAND AND SET ME FREE
YO HO THE SEA OF BLACK
NONE WHO VENTURE THERE COME BACK
UNDER THE SUN
AND UNDER THE MOON
A PIRATES LIFE COULD BE YOUR DOOM!

snippet.title: BLOOD IN THE BAYOU - HOMECOMING | Episode 1
snippet.description:
This is episode 1 of Slimecicle's Call of Cthulu horror campaign, Blood in the Bayou!
Go to https://www.patreon.com/JustRollWithIt NOW and become a member at any tier to hear the rest!

Three high school friends reunite after a decade in their hometown of Galloway, Louisiana to conclude their unfinished Dungeons and Dragons campaign. But after blood is spilled, they quickly realize that the horrors they must face are all but imaginary. 

Slimecicle is the Keeper. Grizzly plays Kian Stone. Condifiction plays Rolan Deep. Bizly plays Rand. 

This series is played in the Call of Cthulhu system, and is a Patreon reward for 3500 patrons!

This series contains profanity, violence, sexual content, and body horror.
